blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About South Meadows

parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in South Meadows, Pitt Meadows?

Active MLS® listings in South Meadows typically include single-family detached homes on wide suburban lots (median 7,204 sq ft lot size in Q3 2026), master-planned riverfront homes and townhomes in Osprey Village (such as Coho II), and rural south-end properties near the Fraser River. In Q3 2026, South Meadows recorded Detached median $1,349,000 ($548/sq ft, 6,011 sq ft lot) · Townhome median $899,900 ($508/sq ft). Every listing at the top of this page updates automatically from the Greater Vancouver Realtors (GVR) MLS® feed.
Which School District 42 schools serve South Meadows in Pitt Meadows?

Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Ave covers 8-12; Pitt Meadows Elementary at 11941 Harris Rd offers French Immersion; Edith McDermott Elementary at 12175 Bonson Rd covers K-7. Those are the public schools serving or near South Meadows. Catchment boundaries depend on the exact street address, so verify them with the locator for School District 42 (Maple Ridge – Pitt Meadows) before you remove subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near South Meadows?

Residents of South Meadows enjoy access to Waterfront Commons Park in Osprey Village (10935 Barnston View Rd), Fraser River dike trail, Mitchell Park, and South Bonson Community Centre. See our companion
South Meadows Neighbourhood Guide
for full park addresses, trail networks, and community recreation details.
How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in South Meadows?

Primary commuter and road corridors serving South Meadows include Bonson Road, Airport Way, Golden Ears Way (to Golden Ears Bridge), Baynes Road, and Pitt Meadows Regional Airport (YPK), connecting residents to Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, the Golden Ears Bridge, and TransLink RapidBus (R3) and West Coast Express commuter rail stations.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or ALR rules apply in South Meadows?

South Meadows spans urban single-family (R-1) and comprehensive development zones around Osprey Village along with south-end ALR parcels under City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011; buyers near Airport Way should also review YPK airport noise and height contours. Pitt Meadows Zoning Guide
What are the 2021 Statistics Canada Census demographics for South Meadows?

According to the 2021 Statistics Canada Census (custom GVR sub-area boundary compilation), South Meadows has a population of 4,105 across 1,490 occupied private dwellings, a median household income of $132,000, and an owner-occupancy rate of 88%.
